title: two fingers spreading on a photo viewer zoom it

interactions.name: the page's listeners work over the mirror
the second finger reaches the page
the fingers spreading zoom the page in

interaction.reason: a second finger is dropped where it lands: the client takes only the primary pointer, so a pinch is at best a one-finger drag and the page never sees the gesture it is built on

notes: reported in words rather than a scale factor: the question is whether two pointers exist at all, and a numeric zoom would flap on a pixel of cross-half layout difference
